title: Cardholder Liability Figures for a Lost or Stolen Paystride Visa Payroll Card
content:
For unauthorized use of a lost or stolen Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account card, the following figures apply on every plan (Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential through Elite).

| | Essential | Standard | Select | Advantage | Premier | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days after learning of the loss or theft within which a report is timely | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Liability cap for a loss or theft reported on time, US dollars | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| Liability cap for a loss or theft reported later, US dollars | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Visa Zero Liability applies to purchases | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Questions on the figures

**Is the timely-report period counted in calendar days?** No. It is counted in business days, Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays.

**Does any plan carry different caps?** No. The two caps and the report period are the same on all six plans, and Visa Zero Liability applies on all six.
